title: warp 10, two-engine ram scoops, an under-engined design, fuel generators, starbases, task gates, keeping warp, equal factors, chasers, rounding, RHRS colonists

cases.setup: 100 LH6 scouts in one fleet, warp 10, +100 x, 30000 mg: each ship lost with chance 1/10 (expect about 10; 2-20 covers 99.6%); the survivors' fuel = 30000 - trunc(30000 x lost/100) - cost
50 Trans-Star 10 scouts (rated), warp 10, +100 x: none lost
one fleet of 50 LH6 and 50 Trans-Star 10 scouts, warp 10: only LH6 scouts are lost
Large Freighter with 2 RHRS, warp 4, +100 x, 1000 mg: 2 x 6 x 16 = 192
the same at warp 2 (free 3, 4, 5): 2 x 10 x 4 = 80
Large Freighter with 1 of 2 LH6, warp 5, +100 x, 2600 mg: factor 99999, so it moves only its tiny range and ends with 0 (warp unchanged: no warp is free)
AMG scout stationary in deep space, 100 of 250 mg: +50
AMG scout, warp 5, +25 x, 100 mg: pays the move, then +50
AMG scout stationary, 230 of 250 mg: capped at 250
2 Super-Fuel Xports stationary, 1000 of 4500 mg: +200 each
Super-Fuel Xport, warp 6, +36 x, 1000 mg: pays, then +200
QJ5 scout (50 mg) orbiting player 1's planet 5 with a Space Dock; player 1 is an enemy toward player 0: not refuelled
QJ5 scout (50 mg) orbiting player 0's planet 0 with an Orbital Fort: not refuelled
MF LH6 at own planet 1 (no starbase), 300 mg, transport "unload all" fuel: the fleet ends with 0 (fuel unloaded onto a planet is lost)
minelayer scout with "lay mines" at waypoint 0 and a second waypoint 30 ly away, warp 5: does not move

MF LH6 at own planet 2 with 50 Ir, transport "unload all" Ir at waypoint 0, second waypoint 30 ly away, warp 5: unloads before movement, the task ends, it moves (KERNEL's "transport does not move" holds only while the task is open)
QJ5 scout, warp 6, +100 x, 10 mg: cannot afford the leg (14 mg) but keeps fuel after this year's 36 ly: keeps warp 6
SF QJ5 (design 10) + SF LH6 (design 11), 50 kT, warp 5, +25 x: cargo on design 10 first: 140 tenths, 14 mg (design 11 first would give 141, 15 mg)
SF LH6 (design 14) + SF QJ5 (design 15), 50 kT, warp 5, +25 x: cargo on design 14 first: 141 tenths, 15 mg
QJ5 scout (2 mg), warp 6, chasing a stationary scout 100 ly away: fuel-limited like an ordinary leg, ends with 0, warp 1
FM scout (100 mg), warp 4, chasing a stationary scout 100 ly away: ram scoop +16
QJ5 scout (102 mg), warp 9, chasing a stationary scout 126 ly away: topped up to 37
QJ5 scout, warp 5, from (1395, 1395) toward (1345, 1366): rounds half away from zero on both axes
QJ5 scout, warp 6, from (1395, 1380) toward (1300, 1349)
QJ5 scout, warp 7, from (1390, 1010) toward (1290, 1067)
MF RHRS with 100 kT colonists, warp 4, +100 x: loses 18
MF RHRS with 3 kT colonists, warp 4, +100 x: loses 1
MF RHRS with 100 kT colonists, stationary: loses 0
player 0 QJ5 scout (fleet number high) and player 1 LH6 scout (fleet 0) chase each other at warp 4, 20 ly apart: player 0 moves first (12 ly), player 1 meets it (8)
